text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
――Let's begin. The 1st Strategy Meeting 
for "Operation: Teio's Comeback at the All 
Comers".

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Geez, Ikuno's meddling has really reached 
its peak, huh? Who helps out someone 
they're running against in the exact same 
race?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, that's what makes 
Ikuno so great... or rather, so amazing, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, aren't you pretty big on taking 
care of people too, Nature?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Don't go giving up on your own, Teio," 
she was muttering all by herself in front 
of the hollow last night, too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You were watching?! Don't you dare tell 
anyone about that, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeeees. Mfufu~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—So, what should we do? Be Turbo's 
training partners or something?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'd like the two of you to act as 
their opponents, while I handle schedule 
adjustments and pre- and post-training 
care for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. So, what's on the menu for 
training?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Regarding that, I asked a certain person 
to help us formulate a strategy this time.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The training regimen aligned with the 
strategy will be explained to Turbo and 
the two of you by that person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Good day to you all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've heard the whole story from Ikuno-san. 
I will gladly cooperate to help Turbo-san 
win the "All Comers."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whaa!? Our helper is— McQueen of all 
people!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san, I'll leave the rest to you, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will contact you once I reach a 
good stopping point.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh, Ikuno, are you going somewhere!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san and I are rivals in this race. I 
can't go finding out your strategy in 
advance.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
While McQueen-san is teaching everyone the 
strategy, I'll go ahead and prepare some 
light refreshments and handle other 
arrangements.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to compete fairly with Ms. 
Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...! Understood!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“—First, shall we go over the requirements 
for this upcoming All Comers?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you all already know this, but... 
This time, having a countermeasure against 
Ikuno is an absolute must.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Having forged her running through 
countless races, she is truly a 
battle-hardened veteran.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
With a predictable Front Runner strategy, 
she will almost certainly be chased down 
from behind.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...When McQueen says it, it's insanely 
convincing.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
B-But! Even if it's against Ikuno, Turbo 
wants to make a huge breakaway lead! Just 
like in the Tanabata Sho the other day!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —That is the one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I watched Turbo-san's Tanabata Sho as 
well. That runaway lead was certainly 
astonishing, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The second factor is the unique 
characteristics of Nakayama Racecourse, 
where the All Comers is held.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Regarding that front-running at the 
"Tanabata Sho," it only succeeded because 
of the flat layout of Fukushima 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Pulling off that kind of front-running 
escape at Nakayama Racecourse with its 
steep hill is several levels more 
difficult.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So that means coming up with a plan for 
Ikuno, while pulling off Turbo's 
front-running style at Nakayama. ...Is 
that it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It is just as you say.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Even without guessing, isn't that 
insanely difficult?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But... it's not impossible. I've 
prepared a solid plan.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teach me, McQueen! Turbo really, really 
wants to beat Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: —Eeeek, don't run at full speed~?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Going a bit slower on the straightaway 
midway... Does that mean slacking off?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No. It is not slacking off— it is 
conserving power during the middle leg.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"And then, after rounding the third 
corner, you unleash that pent-up power in 
an explosive burst—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You could call it a "variable two-stage 
front-runner strategy." That is our tactic 
for this race.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, Turbo wants all-out! Just like 
always, going all-out without thinking 
about anything is the be~st!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Running like I did at the "Tanabata Sho" 
is way more guaranteed to make everyone 
go, "Gwwaaah?!"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why, Turbo-san. This 
strategy builds upon and makes full use of 
your front-running in the 'Tanabata Sho'."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To explain it—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—With her completely unhinged breakaway at 
the Tanabata Sho, the other camps came to 
know Turbo's madness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Getting caught up in that kind of pace 
will only lead to self-destruction." 
Everyone is paralyzed with fear...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ikuno is no exception to this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is why, subconsciously, they keep 
their distance. Even when Turbo drops her 
pace, they hold back farther than 
necessary—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The “variable two-stage front-running” 
strategy is meant to exploit that lapse in 
their thinking.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I see. And by the time they notice 
Turbo speeding up at the end, it'll 
already be too late, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But this tactic... puts an immense 
strain on Turbo herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A final spurt driven by a sudden shift in 
gears—whether one can withstand that 
strain will likely be a key factor as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, if we can pull this off—we should 
be able to catch Ikuno-san off guard and 
escape her pursuit.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Can Turbo really do something like 
that? I'm way better at running with an 
empty head, and—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, I don't really have the 
confidence...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...It is just as you said, Ikuno-san.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why, Ikuno—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...That person foresaw the possibility 
that Turbo-san might get cold feet 
regarding my strategy."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Even without knowing the details, you 
knew that if I were the one proposing it, 
it would be extremely harsh for the sake 
of victory. ...Yes, you understood that, 
didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Disciplining myself to accomplish the 
mission. That person understood very 
well... that such was my nature."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, I was given a message 
to deliver in case Turbo-san got scared.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Are you going to give up? Just like 
Teio-san is right now?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"‘In that case, this contest shall be my 
victory.’"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: —...No way.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No matter how tough or painful it is, 
Turbo's gonna do it...! I'll show you I 
can!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo won't give up!! Never, ever gonna 
give up!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely pull off McQueen's 
strategy!! And then, I'll beat Ikuno!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —That's the spirit.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Okay Turbo, first I'm gonna put on the 
pressure just like Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Got it!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: —Oryaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo! Control your pace more!! You'll 
burn out too early at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …………Hey, um.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What made you decide to help out with 
this, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I thought it was pretty 
unexpected. ...Is it for Teio's sake?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...To be frank, I suppose it is for the 
sake of the "future."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The future...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When Ikuno-san consulted me about this 
matter...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I want all Umamusume to keep running for 
as long as they desire."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I can't just ignore Teio-san 
when she's trying to give up, nor 
Turbo-san when she's trying to cheer her 
on." ...That is what she said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...It was such a pure gaze.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"A sincere light that truly worries for 
'our' future and wishes to be of help—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"—To that light. To the 'future' 
illuminated by that brilliance."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I simply felt the desire to lend a 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There was a time when I myself struggled 
with leg issues, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —She really is loved... Ikuno is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as time marched steadily toward the 
All Comers—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: —*pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"I-I did it... right? Turbo just did that, 
didn't she...?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Splendidly done...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You've really worked hard...! Now, all 
that's left is to let it all out in the 
All Comers!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Seriously, you did amazing to make 
it this far, Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Everyone, good work on today's training.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ikuno...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The refreshments and stretches are all 
ready to go. Shall we get right to it?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ikuno! Turbo's definitely gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna train tons and tons, and unleash 
the ultimate Turbo engine!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: That's why— it's a showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am looking forward to it. To competing 
with you with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The All Comers is approaching. The 
fateful race between Twin Turbo, Tokai 
Teio, and Ikuno Dictus."
